series: IF YOUR WEBSITE WERE A… — EP. 03

slides.title: If your website were a riad.

slides.label: FIRST IMPRESSION
slides.title: The homepage is the front door.
slides.body: Carved, clean and welcoming. Guests decide in seconds whether to knock.

slides.label: FRONTEND
slides.title: Frontend is the courtyard.
slides.body: Everything guests see and feel: light, tiles, fountain, the path to every room.

slides.label: BACKEND
slides.title: Backend is the kitchen.
slides.body: Guests never see it, but every breakfast and every tagine comes out of it on time.

slides.label: API
slides.title: The API is the host.
slides.body: Takes the guest's request, walks it to the kitchen and brings back exactly what was asked.

slides.label: DATABASE
slides.title: The database is the guest register.
slides.body: Every booking, name and date written down, found again in seconds.

slides.label: SECURITY
slides.title: Security is the key to each room.
slides.body: Each guest opens only their own door. No key, no entry.

slides.label: MAINTENANCE
slides.title: Maintenance is housekeeping.
slides.body: Every morning, quietly: fresh sheets, fixed taps, nothing broken when guests return.

slides.label: PERFORMANCE
slides.title: Speed is the rooftop view.
slides.body: The moment guests arrive and everything is already there, effortless.

slides.label: DEPLOYMENT
slides.title: Launch is the first guest arriving.
slides.body: Lanterns lit, mint tea poured, the door opens. Your website is live.

slides.title: We build the whole riad.
slides.body: Front door to kitchen: design, development and launch, all in one place.
